title: Back to Brunswick Street
text: The old ground in the Edinburgh Gardens still has its grandstand, and the members want one session a year back there. The facilities are poor and the surface is patchy.

choices.result: A full session at the usual base. Some of the old guard feel forgotten.

choices.label: Cut the football department

title: Homeless again
text: The landlord club has raised the rent on the shared ground and pushed Fitzroy into the worst training slots. A suburban council has offered its oval cheaply, a long way from the heartland.

effects.why: The club stayed close to its heartland

title: The interstate cheque
text: A government in a city without its own team will pay well for Fitzroy to play two home games there. The money is real. So is the travel, and the members lose two days at home.

text: An interstate club with deep pockets and few members has offered to take over Fitzroy's licence and players. Its directors say the name would live on, and nobody believes them.

choices.result: The club stays itself. The bank stays nervous.

hit.why: The members heard the club was talking to buyers

effects.hit_result: The talks leak, and the members turn.

title: Dinner with the old premiership sides
text: The club historians want the players at a Thursday night dinner honouring the old premiership sides, the Unbeatables among them. The legends would love to meet the current group.
